name: Binding post, red (Keystone 7004)
summary: Screw-down binding post that also takes 4 mm banana plugs. Needs an 8.4 mm hole.
source: Keystone catalogue page 108, standard binding post 7004 (red, 7005 black): cap 0.423 in (10.8 mm) across, standing 0.719 in (18.3 mm) above the panel and reaching 0.828 in (21.1 mm) behind it, for panels up to 0.281 in (7.1 mm). The mounting hole is 0.328 in (8.4 mm) round with a flat 0.250 in (6.4 mm) across that stops it turning; the opening here is round, so add the flat by hand or rely on the nut. Rated 15 A.
